Name: Uttendorf I
note: OeBB Bahnstromkraftwerk Uttendorf I, lower stage of the Stubachtal group sharing the building with Uttendorf II (66 MW, 1991, present in powerplantmatching as 'Uttendorf'). Source of the 27 MW: AGGM derivation - OpenStreetMap gives 93 MW for both Uttendorf stages together (https://openinframap.org/stats/area/Austria/plants/28620626) and Uttendorf II is 66 MW (https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kraftwerksgruppe_Stubachtal), hence 93 - 66 = 27 MW for stage I; no source states the figure directly. Cross-check: Enzingerboden 81 + Schneiderau 35 + Uttendorf 93 + Gruensee 0.5 = 209.5 MW against the KLIEN catchment 40302 non-pumped capacity of 212 MW

Name: Plankenau
